title: gladiolus angustifolius
intro: Gladiolus angustifolius, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Sword-lily or Narrow-leaved Gladiolus, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Iridaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its ability to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Gladiolus angustifolius include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of respiratory problems, wounds, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antitumor properties.
